title: Demand Planner
description:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc., has an opening in its Anderson, SC office for a Demand Planner that is responsible for maintaining an accurate Production, Sales, and Inventory Plan to support company and customer expectations within acceptable inventory targets.

We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package -- tuition assistance, 401(k), medical/dental/vision coverage, vacation and holidays.

Scope

This position will define inventory targets and purchasing needs to support company sales while exceeding service level and turns targets. Demand Planners work closely with multiple associates across the supply chain to ensure expectations are clearly defined, including:

• Sales managers, product development teams, supervisor and customer to capture best collaborative forecast

• Factory teams to ensure expectations are clearly defined and that goods ship on time while managing inventory within budget requirements.

• Purchasing to ensure factory purchase orders are aligned to timing needs

• Customers to align retail sales expectations, assist with the containerization of direct flow goods, and address opportunities

• Distribution to make sure orders are shipping timely and event expectations are communicated.

Primary Responsibilities

Demand Planners maintain a PSI (Production, Sales, and Inventory Plan), improve processes, exceed company service level expectations, and define opportunities to reduce costs.

• Define inventory needs to support customer replenishment and event execution

• Obtain, analyze and interpret supply chain relevant data from multiple sources

• Define factory orders to ensure an adequate supply of finished product for required forecasted demand

• Coordinate receiving priorities and order exceptions with Distribution

• Maintain reports critical to business function, including financial forecast, inventory projections, and service performance

• Schedule regular meetings and report out all potential supply chain failures and opportunities

• Capture failures, root cause, corrective action, and document accountability

• Address customer emergencies and manage through to resolve

• Assist with Customer Compliancy Disputes

• Build relationships throughout supply chain to recognize and address process improvement opportunities

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Operations, or related field preferred OR equivalent experience.

• Minimum 2 years  of Supply Chain experience

• Well versed in Microsoft Office Suite applications with advanced Excel skills

• Demonstrate statistical, analytical and mathematical aptitude

title: Electrical Engineer II - Embedded Hardware
description:
Job Description:

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.; sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.

INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence.

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE.

The Electrical Engineer II will independently design, prototype, test, and troubleshoot embedded electronic systems for low- to mid-complexity projects. This role will collaborate with global engineering teams, product managers, test engineering, and suppliers to deliver robust, cost-effective, and manufacturable designs. The engineer will apply platform and reuse principles, make data-driven technical decisions, and support platform designs from concept through qualification and release.

You'll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Independently design, prototype, test, and troubleshoot embedded electronic hardware and supporting firmware for low- to mid-complexity product and platform projects.

• Develop analog and digital circuits that may include microcontrollers, power supplies, sensors, communication interfaces, protection circuits, and signal-conditioning functions.

• Create and review schematics, support PCB layout, perform circuit simulations, and apply sound design practices for signal integrity, noise, reliability, cost, and manufacturability.

• Develop engineering requirements, test plans, procedures, and test cases for electronic components, printed circuit board assemblies, subsystems, and complete electronics platforms.

• Use laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, data-acquisition systems, power analyzers, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, and protocol analyzers as applicable.

• Conduct experiments, analyze data using appropriate statistical methods, document results, and draw concise, logical conclusions that guide design decisions.

• Perform root-cause analysis and resolve hardware, firmware-interaction, test, and platform integration issues with urgency and disciplined problem solving.

• Evaluate technical tradeoffs and recommend solutions that balance performance, user needs, schedule, cost, reliability, regulatory compliance, and reuse capability.

• Collaborate with component suppliers and manufacturing partners to select components, address availability or quality concerns, and support successful platform launches.

• Work with cross-functional and global teams to incorporate platform-based design approaches and reusable technical solutions across product categories.

• Track assigned work to project schedules, surface risks early, and communicate status, decisions, and recommendations to technical teams and management.

• Prepare agendas, facilitate technical reviews, document decisions and action items, and deliver clear presentations to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and technicians while modeling Milwaukee Tool culture and engineering best practices.

• Build and maintain knowledge of Milwaukee Tool development and manufacturing processes to support efficient, high-quality designs.

• Support design qualification to applicable safety, EMC, wireless, and product standards based on the scope of the design.

What TOOLS you'll bring with you:

• Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

• 2+ years of experience in electrical or embedded hardware design, development, validation, or a closely related engineering role.

• Working knowledge of embedded systems, analog and digital circuit design, PCBA design and manufacturing, and electronics verification and validation fundamentals.

• Experience with schematic-capture, PCB-layout, and circuit-simulation tools.

• Ability to select components, review datasheets, perform engineering calculations, and translate system needs into component- and circuit-level requirements.

• Experience using standard electronics laboratory equipment and applying structured troubleshooting methods.

• Working knowledge of C programming for microcontrollers and the interaction between firmware and electronics.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document work and explain technical tradeoffs.

• Excellent problem-solving skills, sound independent judgment, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

• Self-motivated, organized, efficient, process-oriented, and committed to high-quality engineering work.

• Ability to travel up to 10% of the time, domestically and internationally.

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

• Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

• Experience with embedded communications, Bluetooth Low Energy, wired serial interfaces, antenna or RF circuits, or low-power electronic design.

• Knowledge of firmware development tools and an additional programming language such as Python or C++.

• Experience with design of experiments, automated test development, data acquisition, or statistical analysis.

• Knowledge of electronic component reliability, failure modes, design for manufacturability, and design for test.

• Familiarity with applicable regulatory and certification standards such as UL, FCC, ISED/IC, CE, CEC, or ANSI.

• Hands-on experience with soldering, rework, prototype assembly, and test-fixture development.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

• Robust health, dental, and vision insurance plans.

• Generous 401(k) savings plan.

• Education assistance.

• On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service.

• And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Field Sales and Marekting Representative - Lompoc, CA
description:
Job Description:

Field Sales and Marketing Representative – Techtronic Industries, NA (TTI)

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provide TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in driving market share growth and maintaining TTI’s premier product lines within The Home Depot—our most valued and influential retail partner. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. Your contributions will directly impact TTI’s presence in the retail space, positioning you for continued advancement within the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

·          Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.

·          Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through.

·          Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.

·          Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact.

·          Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics.

·          Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market.

·          Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships.

·          Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities.

·          Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

·          Must be at least 21 years of age or older.

·          Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

·          Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

·          Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.

·          Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

·          Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

·          Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

·          Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

·          Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.

·          Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.

·          Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

·          Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

·          Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

·          Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

·          The applicant must be MS Office proficient.

·          Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.

·          Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.

·          Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits:

• Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)

• The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000

• Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)

• Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year

• Company iPhone and iPad

• Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available

• Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more

• 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)

• Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holiday (Based on hire date)

• Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date

• Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business

• Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

Job Postings are available for at least 48 hours from the posting date. TTI accepts ongoing applications and will evaluate based on the needs of the business.

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at www.ttirecruiting.com.

title: Firmware Engineer II
description:
Job Description:

INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence.

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE.

The Firmware Engineer II will collaborate with and establish trusting relationships with engineers and cross-functional teams locally and globally. You will participate in the new product development process supporting deliverables at key milestones.

You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Working independently, design, prototype, test, and troubleshoot embedded systems including application functions and libraries for real-time applications and low to mid-level complexity projects.

• Develop and execute test plans and procedures for firmware applications and subsystems.

• Use laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, and data acquisition systems.

• Conduct experiments, perform simulations, and draw concise, logical conclusions by analyzing data.

• Track projects to ensure adherence to schedule and communicate status updates to other teams and mid-level management.

• Role model Milwaukee Tool’s culture while providing technical guidance, mentorship, and coaching junior Engineers.

• Work with component suppliers and manufacturers for proper component selection on existing projects and providing input into future product needs.

• Schedule, develop agendas for, facilitate, and document technical meetings and formal presentations.

• Acquire knowledge and maintain an understanding of Milwaukee Tool’s development and manufacturing processes to effectively and efficiently mass produce power tools.

• Design and qualify new solutions to applicable regulatory standards such as UL, CEC, CE, and ANSI.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• Bachelor of Science Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

• 2+ years of experience with embedded C/C++ or a comparable programming language for embedded systems.

• Experience with one or more of the following:  DevOps, automated testing (LabView), continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), hardware in the loop (HIL), unit testing, structural testing methodologies, National Instrument hardware, and TestStand.

• Experience with software configuration management tools, defect tracking tools, and peer reviews.

• Excellent problem-solving skills, exercises independent judgement and works well under pressure in a dynamic environment.

• Self-motivated, organized, efficient, process oriented with a strong work ethic.

• Exceptional verbal and writing skills.

• Ability to travel 10% of the time (domestic and international).

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

• Master’s Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

• Experience with CAD tools, particularly those relevant to electrical/PCB design.

• “Bare metal” C/C++ programming experience outside of an OS/RTOS.

• Experience developing bare-metal firmware designs for real-time applications.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

• Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans.

• Generous 401 (K) savings plan.

• Education assistance.

• On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service.

• And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

description:
Job Description:

INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive modern technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we are pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence.

Behind our doors you will be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you will have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE.

The Firmware Test Engineer II will collaborate and establish trusting relationships with cross-functional engineering and testing teams to support Test Management across the firmware verification lifecycle.  You will help translate requirements into clear, testable, traceable and automation-ready verification solutions that support new product development deliverables at key milestones.

You will also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Review firmware, hardware, and system requirements for clarity, completeness, and testability.

• Identify requirement gaps, ambiguities, risks, and traceability issues.

• Design and maintain test cases for firmware features and subsystems of low- to mid-level complexity with supervision from Senior/Principal engineers.

• Support HIL test development by identifying needed interfaces, instrumentation, and test resources.

• Develop and maintain Python-based automated test scripts.

• Configure and execute tests using HIL systems, development hardware, and laboratory equipment.

• Analyze test failures and help isolate issues to firmware, hardware, test automation, or test setup.

• Document test results, objective evidence, and defects with clear, reproducible details.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in Agile projects and participate in technical reviews.

• Contribute to reusable test assets, automation frameworks, process improvements, and continuous learning.

• Use Agile methods to define tasks, provide estimates, and communicate progress to ensure adherence to schedule and Milwaukee Tool’s processes.

• Schedule, develop agendas for, lead, and document technical meetings and formal presentations.

What TOOLS you will bring with you:

• Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field

• 2+ years of experience with verification and validation testing, embedded systems and/or PCBA design.

• Experience with requirements management, defect tracking, source control, or peer review tools such as JAMA, Azure DevOps, Jira, Polarion, or similar platforms.

• Ability to read schematics and datasheets and apply a working understanding of digital circuits and firmware/electronics interaction.

• Experience developing or reviewing test cases or test procedures from requirements.

• Working proficiency in Python, including the ability to write, execute, and debug test scripts.

• Familiarity with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power supplies, electronic loads, data acquisition systems, or multimeters.

• Structured problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate failures across software, firmware, hardware, and test setup boundaries.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document requirements gaps, test rationale, results, and defects clearly.

• Experience collaborating cross-functionally outside of your core discipline which includes accepting technical feedback, managing assigned work, and exercising sound judgment with appropriate guidance.

• Ability to travel up to 10%, domestically and internationally.

Other TOOLS, we prefer you to have:

• Exposure HIL testing, simulation, test-fixture development, or automated test systems.

• Experience with National Instruments hardware, TestStand, VeriStand, or LabVIEW.

• Experience with black-box and white-box testing, bare-metal firmware, embedded C or C++, unit testing, or structural testing methods.

• Exposure to DevOps, automated regression testing, or continuous integration and delivery pipelines.

• Experience using AI-assisted engineering or programming tools to

• improve productivity and quality.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

• Must be at least 21 years of age or older.

• Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

• Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

• Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.

• Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

• Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

• Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

• Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

• Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.

• Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.

• Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

• Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

• Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

• The applicant must be MS Office proficient.

title: Forklift Operator - Manufacturing
description:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc. is seeking a Stand-Up Forklift Operator for our Day Shift Manufacturing operations in Anderson, SC. We offer competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package, including tuition assistance, 401(k), medical, dental, vision coverage, paid vacation, and holidays.

Position Summary

The Stand-Up Forklift Operator is responsible for safely operating powered industrial equipment while supporting warehouse and manufacturing operations through picking, packing, repackaging, unloading, and inventory-related activities. This position plays a critical role in maintaining product accuracy, safety, quality, and customer satisfaction.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Complete assigned picking, packing, repackaging, and unloading tasks.

• Operate stand-up forklift and material handling equipment safely and efficiently.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

• Ensure inventory accuracy and order fulfillment accuracy.

• Follow all company safety, security, and quality policies.

• Utilize basic math skills and weight scales to complete job functions.

• Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE).

• Demonstrate a cooperative and professional attitude with coworkers and management.

• Adhere to production schedules and work overtime and weekends as needed.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives within the department.

• Perform additional duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Education

• High School Diploma or GED preferred.

Experience

• Minimum of 3 to 6 months of experience in a manufacturing or warehouse environment preferred.

• Previous forklift operation experience required.

• Licensed or certified Lift Truck Operator required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Ability to accurately add and multiply numbers.

• Ability to read and understand written English instructions.

• Ability to work from pick lists, work orders, and operating instructions.

• Ability to maintain productivity standards, including picking up to 200 line items.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand for extended periods.

• Frequent repetitive motion throughout the shift.

• Frequent bending, stooping, pushing, and pulling.

• Regular lifting of up to 50 pounds independently.

• Team lifting required for items exceeding 50 pounds.

• Ability to work in varying temperature conditions.

• Ability to continuously move products of varying weights throughout the workday.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Working Conditions

• Fast-paced warehouse and manufacturing environment.

• Exposure to moving equipment, forklifts, and warehouse traffic.

• Variable temperatures depending on season and operational needs.

• Overtime and weekend work may be required based on business demands.

Key Performance Expectations

• Maintain safety compliance with zero preventable incidents.

• Meet picking and productivity standards.

• Achieve inventory and order accuracy goals.

• Adhere to quality requirements and operational procedures.

• Demonstrate reliability, attendance, and teamwork.

Internal Candidate Requirements

Internal applicants must meet the following qualifications:

• No active Final Written Warnings.

• No more than six (6) attendance points.

• Meet efficiency and quality performance standards for the previous three months.

• Minimum of six (6) months in current position.

• Meet all qualifications and requirements outlined in this job description.

title: Sr Advanced Quality Engineer - Fall Protection
description:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one.

All our teams touch every step of the process, that is why our Engineering teams are some of the key contributors to our continuous innovations. The fast-paced, agile environment continuously delivers disruptive technologies by providing every team with the resources needed to excel and working directly with End Users to understand how to deliver heavy-duty products with high performance. We create Best-in-class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes and cross-functional agility.

The Sr. Advanced Quality Engineer – Fall Protection provides quality and reliability engineering leadership to cross-functional project teams developing and manufacturing occupational fall-protection products. The AQE directly interfaces with New Product Development, Product Support, and Value Engineering teams. Primary duties are to lead and direct the quality activities of project teams to successfully meet Project Quality Objectives as well as project goals including Time-To-Market, Cost, and Performance for this highly regulated and safety critical category.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Serve as the Sr. Team lead for the Quality and Reliability function while supporting process improvement initiatives.

Reliability Functions:

• Collaborate with Engineering, Marketing, and Regulatory teams to translate customer needs and regulatory requirements into product performance and design specifications.

• Apply robust understanding of OSHA, ANSI/ASSP, and EN regulatory compliance ensuring critical safety products protect end users and meet all applicable regulations.

• Support the product design process including benchmarking and testing of concepts & prototypes.

• Develop and execute risk-based test procedures to validate product specifications and ensure Quality and Reliability readiness.

• Lead Risk Assessments (Design and Manufacturing) during the product development cycle.

• Draw concise, logical, written conclusions from experiments based on data analysis

• Perform failure analysis and recommend solutions with corrective action, as required.

• Proactively seek out quality improvements for new and existing products.

Quality Functions - New Product team:

• Work with global operations, materials, manufacturing engineering, and quality engineering teams to develop QC mitigation strategies for high-risk specifications.

• Establish Critical to Quality (CTQ) characteristics and controls for high strength textile-based products.

• Provide technical guidance to develop manufacturing, inspection, and testing requirements for safety critical products with various teams at both internal and supplier facilities.

• Lead supplier evaluation, process qualification, capability assessment, manufacturing readiness, and quality planning for global suppliers and manufacturing sites

• Collaborate with US, European, and Asian based manufacturing and supplier representatives to ensure operational readiness of new product launches.

• Participate in the evaluation and selection of suppliers.

• Able to call, lead and conduct global, cross functional team members with the following participants: New product development engineering, internal/external operations/suppliers, quality and supply chain.

Requirements:

Master’s or equivalent degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing/Production, Materials Engineering or related engineering field and 2 years of relevant experience or Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing/Production, Materials Engineering or related engineering field and 5 years of relevant experience.  Experience must include:

• Regulated new product development environment.

• Research and development with soft goods, natural or synthetic materials that are flexible including but not limited to textiles, foams, rubber, films or equivalent.

• Manufacturing quality experience in a regulated product field

• Test development and execution experience in a regulated product field

• Engineering tools such as Critical to Quality/Quality Function Deployment, Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T), Statistical Process Control (SPC), Design of Experiments (DOE), Control Plans, Risk Analysis through Failure Modes Effects Analysis (FMEA) and metrology methods

• Statistical tools such as MiniTab

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Heat Treat Processor - 1st shift
description:
GNA Heat Treat Processor
Job Description:

INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence.

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE.

You'll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

The Heat Treat Processor will ensure the correct products are being processed through build up and break down and that production goals are met, complete all associated paperwork, and will assist the production areas in various tasks including sorting, counting, 5S activities, replenishing supplies, organizing stock, cleaning equipment, and other assignments. May serve as a backup to other positions at the direction of management; other duties as assigned.

Duties and Responsibilities – Build Up

• Distribute blades and cassettes to and from build up personnel

• Communicate with scheduler / Ipsen tech to ensure correct blades are available

• Track daily production on shift report

• Perform work per work instructions and area metrics

• Keep work area clean and organized

• Inform proper personnel of material shortage

• Train others in area

• Adhere to all safety requirements in the work area

• Practice 5Ss

Duties and Responsibilities – Break Down

• Pull samples from each load per sampling plan, document, and deliver to quality lab

• Track daily production via weigh scale and fill out load and shift reports

• Distribute materials to and from breakdown personnel

• Perform work per work instructions and area metrics

• Keep work area clean and organized

• Inform proper personnel of material shortage

• Train others in area

• Adhere to all safety requirements in the work area

• Practice 5Ss

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Understand and follow verbal and written instructions

• Basic math skills

• Work well with others

Education and Experience Requirements

• High school diploma or equivalent

We provide these great perks and benefits:

• Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans.

• Generous 401 (K) savings plan.

• Education assistance.

• On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service.

• And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Materials Operator
description:
Job Description:

Your Role on Our Team

At Milwaukee Tool, we are committed to delivering high-quality, innovative solutions to our users. The Material Operator plays a critical role in supporting manufacturing operations by ensuring the safe, accurate, and efficient flow of materials throughout the facility. This position is responsible for receiving, storing, moving, stocking, and shipping materials while maintaining inventory accuracy and supporting uninterrupted production. The role focuses on safety, operational efficiency, and system accuracy in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities

• Consistently demonstrates safety first mindset; follows all safety related processes and procedures, quickly escalates safety related concerns or issues to create a safe work environment for all employees.

• Safely and efficiently operate material handling equipment, including forklifts, high-reach trucks (up to 30 feet), and swing-reach trucks, while meeting productivity, quality, and safety standards.

• Load and unload trailers, containers, and transportation vehicles safely, efficiently, and in compliance with established procedures.

• Maintain work area per 6s facility standards without direction.

• Execute material handling activities based on operational requirements, which may include equipment operation, production line replenishment, container unloading, shipping support, or a combination of warehouse and production support functions.

• Receive inbound shipments, verify materials against receiving documentation, and accurately transfer inventory to designated storage locations in accordance with established procedures.

• Store, stack, and organize raw materials, components, and finished goods to maximize safety, space utilization, and operational efficiency.

• Ensure continuous production flow by timely replenishment of materials and components at assembly and manufacturing workstations.

• Transport finished goods from production areas to designated staging, warehouse, or shipping locations in a safe and efficient manner.

• Return excess, unused, or recovered materials to appropriate inventory locations and complete all required inventory transactions accurately.

• Pick, prepare, stage, load, and ship customer orders while verifying product accuracy, quantities, and shipping destinations.

• Maintain accurate inventory records through timely system transactions and proper documentation of material movements to support inventory integrity and ERP system accuracy.

• Perform daily equipment inspections, maintain required operating and safety logs, and adhere to all company safety, quality, and operational policies and procedures.

• Support warehouse and production team objectives through flexibility, teamwork, and effective communication across departments.

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance safety, efficiency, accuracy, and overall operational performance.

• Assist with cycle counts, physical inventories, and inventory reconciliation activities as assigned.

• Must be able to work unsupervised and handle multiple tasks.

• Collaborate with production, warehouse, quality, and shipping teams to ensure materials are available and moved efficiently throughout the operation.

• Ability to work overtime with advanced or little notice.

• All other duties as assigned.

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

title: Molding Materials Coordinator
description:
Job Description:

Your Role on Our Team

At Milwaukee Tool, we are committed to delivering high-quality, innovative solutions to our users. The Molding Material Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the uninterrupted flow of materials to all molding production areas. This role supports manufacturing operations by monitoring material consumption, maintaining inventory accuracy, coordinating material movement, and ensuring molding machines have the required resin, colorants, and supporting materials available throughout the shift. The Molding Material Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting safety, quality, productivity, and continuous improvement initiatives within the molding department.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities

• Consistently demonstrates safety first mindset; follows all safety related processes and procedures, quickly escalates safety related concerns or issues to create a safe work environment for all employees.

• Ensure molding machines are stocked with the appropriate materials required to maintain production schedules.

• Review daily production schedules and coordinate material requirements for current and upcoming shifts.

• Transport raw materials, resin, colorants, and packaging supplies to designated production areas.

• Load dryers according to established material specifications and drying requirements.

• Monitor dryer performance and material readiness to support production demand.

• Empty, clean, and prepare dryers during material changeovers to prevent contamination.

• Conduct routine material level audits and replenish materials as needed throughout the molding facility.

• Maintain accurate inventory records through physical counts and inventory transactions.

• Perform cycle counts and physical inventories of resins, colorants, and related molding materials.

• Support material traceability requirements and ensure proper labeling and identification of all materials.

• Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material handling equipment safely and effectively.

• Coordinate with Process Technicians, Production Supervisors, and Team Leaders to ensure material availability and resolve shortages.

• Follow First-In-First-Out (FIFO) inventory practices and established material handling procedures.

• Support production changeovers by staging materials and removing obsolete materials from work areas.

• Maintain organized storage areas and support 5S initiatives within the molding department.

• Identify and communicate inventory discrepancies, material quality concerns, or supply risks.

•  Assist with training and cross-functional support for other indirect labor positions as needed.

• Maintain work area, including but not limited to, mold storage, secondary equipment storage and mold crib, per 6s facility standards without direction.

• Adhere to all company safety, quality, environmental, and operational policies.

• Proactively work with team members to meet the needs of the production floor.

• Ability to work overtime with advanced or little notice.

• All other duties as assigned.

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• High School Diploma or GED

• 1 year of molding experience

• Forklift certification (TTI will train)

• Extreme attention to detail

• Experience with excel/reading schedules

• Exposure to Kanban and 5s concepts

• Previous experience as material handler

• Safety conscious

• Speed, Agility & Urgency- Quickly respond to changing priorities, production demands, and equipment issues to support scheduled production requirements while maintaining multiple tasks simultaneously with safety and quality standards.

• User Focused, Solution Driven- Maintain a strong attention to detail and accuracy to ensure equipment performs at the highest level of efficiency to produce quality products for a positive end user experience.

• Extreme Ownership- Takes full accountability for safety, quality, productivity, and equipment readiness by proactively identifying and resolving issues, following through on commitments, and taking initiative to ensure mold set-ups, tooling changes, and production support activities are completed accurately, efficiently, and on schedule.

• One Team Mentality- Maintain excellent attendance and punctuality, supporting smooth operations and team success

• Disruptive Mindset- Bring positive energy that motivates others while working independently or alongside a team

• Candid- Support a culture of transparency and accountability across the department through honest, direct feedback

• Relentless Improvement- The initiative to identify opportunities for process improvement, raising the standard for yourself and your team.

Working Conditions:

• Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus

• Prolonged standing and/or walking for up to 12 hours per shift

title: Sr. Financial Analyst
description:
Job Description:

Sr. Financial Analyst – Finance Systems & Reporting

TTI Consumer Power Tools has an opening for a Sr. Financial Analyst – Finance Systems & Reporting. Reporting to the Finance Manager II - FP&A, this role is critical in driving the financial performance of the business. This position is responsible for owning key financial processes including month-end close, management reporting, finance systems management, and financial reporting to the business.

This is a highly visible and versatile role supporting the entire Greenville campus. The ideal candidate is analytical, results-oriented, and comfortable communicating financial insights to senior leadership.

• Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to quality, accuracy, and continuous improvement

• Proven ability to lead initiatives or projects and drive results

• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making capabilities

• Clear, confident communication skills with both financial and non-financial stakeholders

Requirements

• Bachelor’s Degree with a concentration in Finance, Accounting, or Business Analytics

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Snowflake

• Knowledge of backend Oracle and SAP ERP systems

• Experience with financial systems such as Anaplan or CCH Tagetik preferred

• Experience with SQL and analytical programming tools such as Python, VBA, or similar technologies preferred

title: Field Sales Representative - Ocotillo/Payson, AZ
description:
Job Description:

Field Sales and Marketing Representative – Techtronic Industries, NA (TTI)

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provide TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in driving market share growth and maintaining TTI’s premier product lines within The Home Depot—our most valued and influential retail partner. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. Your contributions will directly impact TTI’s presence in the retail space, positioning you for continued advancement within the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.

• Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through.

• Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.

• Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact.

• Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics.

• Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market.

• Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships.

• Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities.

• Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

• Must be at least 21 years of age or older.

• Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

• Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

• Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.

• Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

• Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

• Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

• Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

• Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.

• Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.

• Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

• Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

• Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

• Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

• The applicant must be MS Office proficient.

• Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.

• Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.

• Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits:

• Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)

• The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000

• Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)

• Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year

• Company iPhone and iPad

• Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available

• Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more

• 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)

• Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holiday (Based on hire date)

• Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date

• Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business

• Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

Job Postings are available for at least 48 hours from the posting date. TTI accepts ongoing applications and will evaluate based on the needs of the business.

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at www.ttirecruiting.com.

title: Project Engineer I
description:
Job Description:

Project Engineer I – New Product Development Engineering (OPE)

The Project Engineer I supports the cross-functional execution of new product development (NPD) programs for outdoor power equipment (OPE). Working under the guidance of experienced project leaders and engineering leadership, this role helps translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements, maintains project plans and risk visibility, coordinates technical deliverables, and supports products from concept through production. The Project Engineer I develops project leadership capability while building strong technical judgment, communication, and accountability.

Key Job Functions & Responsibilities

Project Scope & Requirements

• Supports development and maintenance of product requirements, engineering specifications, and critical-to-quality (CTQ) measures for assigned projects.

• Helps identify where requirements create challenges to performance, cost, quality, or schedule.

• Supports scoping of assigned systems, subsystems, and project deliverables with guidance from senior project leadership.

• Documents decisions, assumptions, open questions, and changes to project scope.

Schedule, Risk & Execution

• Develops and maintains work breakdown structures, action trackers, milestone plans, and project documentation for lower-complexity projects or defined workstreams.

• Tracks deliverables, identifies emerging schedule threats, and escalates issues when support or cross-functional alignment is needed.

• Supports project risk reviews by documenting likelihood, impact, mitigation actions, owners, and closure evidence.

• Coordinates prototype builds, testing, design reviews, pilot builds, and release activities with functional owners.

• Demonstrates consistent follow-through and personal accountability for assigned actions.

Cost, Quality & Product Performance

• Supports product cost tracking, competitive benchmarking, design trade-off analysis, and value engineering activities.

• Works with Design Engineering, Quality, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Compliance, Reliability, and suppliers to resolve project issues.

• Uses data from testing, builds, and supplier feedback to help the team evaluate options and make informed decisions.

• Supports compliance with internal standards and applicable UL, ANSI, CSA, and ISO expectations.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Communication

• Facilitates routine project meetings or defined agenda sections with coaching; records decisions, owners, and due dates.

• Communicates project information clearly through written updates, presentations, and action summaries.

• Builds productive relationships with domestic and global team members and actively incorporates input from others.

• Proactively communicates obstacles and seeks help early enough to protect project commitments.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related engineering discipline.

• Minimum 1 year of experience in engineering, product development, manufacturing, or project work; internships and co-op assignments count toward this requirement.

• Working knowledge of engineering fundamentals, drawings, product testing, and structured problem solving.

• Ability to organize technical information, maintain action trackers, and communicate clearly across functions.

• Strong analytical, planning, and follow-through skills.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, results-driven product development environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with outdoor power equipment, power tools, consumer products, or electromechanical systems.

• Familiarity with NPD stage-gate processes, DFMEA, CTQ development, and design verification.

• Experience supporting prototype or pilot builds and working with global suppliers.

• Basic proficiency with project scheduling, data analysis, and Microsoft Office tools.

Travel

• Up to 10% travel (international and domestic).

title: Project Leader
description:
Job Description:

Project Leader – New Product Development Engineering (OPE)

The Project Leader is accountable for the successful cross-functional delivery of moderate to high-complexity new product development (NPD) programs for outdoor power equipment (OPE). Acting as the primary integrator for the project, this role aligns the team on product requirements and strategy, owns the integrated program plan, and drives closure of gaps related to performance, cost, quality, and schedule. The Project Leader leads through influence, maintains the appropriate level of detail to proactively identify risks, barriers, and decision points, and ensures timely escalation of issues that cannot be resolved within the project team. This role communicates clear, data-driven, and decision-ready recommendations to leadership, enabling effective prioritization and rapid resolution of critical program challenges.

Key Job Functions & Responsibilities

Project Strategy & Scope Ownership

• Owns the coordinated delivery of technical and business objectives, ensuring alignment with both internal and external customer requirements

• Drives convergence of performance, features, cost, schedule, quality, and risk trade-offs.

• Ensures the cross-functional team understands priorities, success criteria, decision rights, and required deliverables.

• Challenges assumptions and identifies opportunities to improve the product, execution plan, and business outcome.

Integrated Execution & Risk Leadership

• Owns the integrated project schedule, critical path, milestone readiness, and operating rhythm across all functions.

• Drives timely closure of cross-functional gaps and escalates constraints when additional authority, resources, or business decisions are required.

• Leads project risk management, including identification, prioritization, mitigation, investment, contingency planning, and decision timing.

• Ensures functional owners maintain credible task-level plans while holding the team accountable for commitments.

• Leads projects independently and adapts the plan as priorities, risks, and business conditions change.

Financial, Quality & Launch Accountability

• Owns product cost, tooling, capital, project spending, and the financial impact of project decisions.

• Drives closure of gaps to product performance, reliability, regulatory, quality, manufacturability, supplier readiness, and launch targets.

• Partners with Operations, Quality, Sourcing, Supply Chain, and suppliers to establish specifications and deliver conforming products.

• Ensures project decisions support scalable, sustainable production and a successful ramp-up.

Team Leadership & Executive Communication

• Creates alignment and accountability between cross functional project teams.

• Provides candid, concise executive updates that communicate status through the lens of outcomes, risks, trade-offs, decisions, and support needed.

• Builds trust, resolves conflict, and maintains team momentum in ambiguous or high-pressure situations.

• Coaches project team members and reinforces strong project leadership practices.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor of Science in an engineering discipline or a closely related technical field.

• Minimum 5 years, preferred 8 years of relevant engineering, product development, manufacturing, or technical project leadership experience.

• Demonstrated success leading cross-functional product development projects of moderate to high complexity.

• Advanced capability in integrated scheduling, risk management, product costing, technical trade-offs, and launch execution.

• Ability to influence across functions, resolve misalignment, and communicate effectively with senior leadership.

• Strong technical aptitude and working knowledge of materials, manufacturing processes, product validation, and supplier development.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with outdoor power equipment, power tools, consumer products, batteries/chargers, or electromechanical systems.

• Experience leading global NPD programs through concept, design, validation, certification, tooling, pilot, and launch.

• Experience with DFMEA, DVP&R, DFM/DFA, PPAP, cost modeling, and project scheduling tools.

• Demonstrated coaching or mentoring of project engineers and cross-functional team members.

Travel

• Up to 15% travel (international and domestic).

title: Set-Up Technician (1st Shift)
description:
Job Description:

WE CREATE EMPOWERED LEADERS! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success -- so we give you the tools you need to be a successful Set Up Technician I.

Expected to understand, promote, and embody Milwaukee Tool’s 6 culture pillars:

• One Team Mentality: working as a team, cross shift and cross functional, to overcome obstacles and promote a healthy, respectful and friendly workplace

• Candid: Respectfully provide and receive honest feedback, escalate issues, and hold others accountable

• Never Settle, Always Improving: Challenge the process and yourself, working to identify ways to improve both, and identify and escalate ways to promote continuous improvement across all aspects of production (safety, quality, process, people, etc.)

• Speed, Agility and Urgency: Maintain an inherent sense of urgency in all aspects of production, and be a flexible team member to help meet production goals

• Empowered Leader: Help guide and coach others to meet production and process expectations, lead by example, be the change you want to see

• Obsessed: Goal driven, focused on meeting production KPI’s, striving to exceed expectations, maintain good attendance

Behind our doors you'll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to support the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you'll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

Your Role on Our Team

The Set-Up Technician is responsible for supporting the manufacturing of product by operating and maintaining equipment and processes that provide optimum customer service. The Set Up Technician supports the production process by setting up, adjusting, and troubleshooting equipment. Set Up Technicians will perform independent operation of various CNC machines, will maintain machine operations, perform independent tool changes and set-up without assistance. Set Up Technicians will also have the ability to cycle through proven and unproven programs to obtain first article without assistance on multiple machine types. This position is responsible for collaborating with other technicians and operators as necessary.

A qualified candidate for this role is experienced in all the responsibilities of an Operator I & II and must show the propensity for further technical demand in addition to the following duties and responsibilities.

Technicians in this category:

• Will have a minimum of 1 year experience at MT or prior relative job experience

• Will be cross-trained on all equipment in area of support

• Will be responsible for knowing and implementing all area specific compliance issues, including quality, environmental, safety and Milwaukee Tool/West Bend policies

• Will contribute to team efforts by participating in continuous improvement projects as required

• Will also assist with training associates as necessary. Also responsible for enhancing the department’s productivity and quality and assisting Supervisor or Team Lead as required

A Shift (1st Shift) Hours: Monday-Thursday, 5:00am-3:00pm

You'll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Follow all safety policies and proactively identify potential safety issues, and practice 6S standards to maintain a safe and clean working environment for all employees

• Maintain production by supporting all equipment in the designated area. Set up, adjust and troubleshoot equipment, including automated operations, controls, robotics, and sensors

• Review programs on numerical and PLC equipment and adjust offsets, as required. Communicate with Supervisor, Team Lead and Maintenance Techs about required ladder logic and PLC troubleshooting.

• Perform preventative maintenance responsibilities. Participate in updates of preventative maintenance schedules. Complete routine equipment inspections and complete required documentation

• Investigate and efficiently assist with diagnosis and resolution of equipment and quality issues, production delays or stoppages. Participate in performing root cause analysis and assist with implementing the best solution

• Troubleshoot and assist in minor equipment repairs. Provide feedback to Maintenance and Supervisor/Team Lead as needed. Learn and complete corrective actions as directed

• Inform Supervisor/Team Lead or Department Manager about processes or equipment requiring attention

• Recommend and participate in completion of continuous improvement projects specifically designed to improve processes, productivity and quality, especially those related to corrective actions

• Monitor the cycles of equipment to verify process is running efficiently and within designated tolerances. Escalate or assist as needed

• Complete other duties as assigned by the Manager/Supervisor, including supporting other shifts if necessary

The TOOLS you'll bring with you:

• Two (2) years of previous experience, and/or equivalent training and experience required

• High School or GED diploma required plus Technical Certification in a Mechanical, Electrical, Automation or related program or equivalent combination of education and experience in maintenance, mechanical, or technical field

• Above basic math skills and reasoning ability

• Leadership, quality communication, interpersonal, and mentoring skills required

• Fork truck certification, overhead crane, CNC programing, understanding of PLC programming

• Established ability to identify and communicate issues and offer proposed solutions

• Excellent attention to detail is required

• Ability to manage interruptions in a professional and respectful manner is essential

• Must demonstrate good written and oral communication skills

• Able to interpret technical data, including drawings and schematics, accurately

• Must be proficient in the use of common inspection and test equipment

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills required

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in maintenance, mechanical, or technical field

description:
Job Description:

INNOVATE without boundaries! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success -- so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to provide technical solutions on our IT Team.

Behind our doors you'll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to support the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you'll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

Your Role on Our Team:

The Senior Manager of Data Engineering leads teams that design, build, operate, and continuously improve enterprise data products and platforms. Reporting to the Director of Data Engineering, this leader is accountable for reliable delivery, engineering quality, team development, and strong partnerships across business, analytics, architecture, governance, security, and technology teams.

This role will advance our Databricks-based data platform and establish practical AI-native engineering capabilities. The Senior Manager will use AI-assisted and agentic development approaches to improve how teams design, code, test, document, deploy, monitor, and support data solutions while maintaining appropriate human oversight, security, data governance, and software engineering controls.

You'll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

Leadership and Team Management

·       Lead, coach, and develop data engineering managers, technical leads, and engineers; establish clear accountability, performance expectations, career paths, and succession plans.

·       Build an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture grounded in ownership, technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

·       Translate enterprise strategy into priorities, capacity plans, delivery roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.

·       Manage employee and partner capacity, budgets, and vendor relationships to deliver the highest-value work efficiently.

·       Communicate effectively with executives, business leaders, architects, product leaders, and technical teams.

Data Engineering Strategy and Delivery

·       Own the delivery and operation of scalable data pipelines, reusable frameworks, curated data products, and platform capabilities supporting analytics, reporting, operational, AI, and machine learning use cases.

·       Partner with product and business leaders to define outcomes, prioritize demand, manage dependencies, and deliver incremental business value.

·       Establish engineering standards for architecture, coding, testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, performance, reliability, and supportability.

·       Improve delivery predictability through portfolio management, agile planning, transparent metrics, risk management, and disciplined execution.

·       Reduce technical debt and operational burden through modernization, automation, reusable patterns, and intentional lifecycle management.

·       Lead incident response and problem management for critical data services, including root-cause analysis and corrective action.

Databricks Platform Leadership

·       Guide migration and modernization of legacy data pipelines and warehouse workloads to scalable Databricks patterns where they provide clear value.

·       Establish reusable ingestion, transformation, orchestration, data quality, deployment, and monitoring frameworks.

·       Optimize platform performance and cost through workload design, cluster and serverless strategies, usage transparency, and FinOps practices.

AI Native Engineering and AI Enablement

·       Define and scale responsible AI-assisted development practices across requirements, design, code generation, review, testing, documentation, deployment, and operations.

·       Evaluate agentic engineering capabilities that automate bounded workflows while preserving human approval, traceability, security, and production controls.

·       Set measurable adoption and effectiveness goals for AI development tools, including cycle time, quality, test coverage, developer experience, and incident reduction.

·       Ensure AI-generated code and artifacts meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, maintainability, intellectual property, testing, and peer review.

·       Partner with AI and data science teams to provide trusted data products, feature pipelines, vector and unstructured data patterns, and model or agent telemetry.

Data Governance Reliability and Security

·       Embed data ownership, metadata, lineage, classification, access controls, retention, and quality rules into engineering workflows and platform services.

·       Define service-level objectives and metrics for data freshness, quality, availability, performance, cost, and recovery.

·       Partner with cybersecurity, privacy, risk, and compliance teams to ensure data products and AI-enabled workflows meet enterprise requirements.

Performs other duties as assigned.

·       Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

·       7 or more years of progressive experience in data engineering, software engineering, data platforms, or related disciplines, including at least three years leading engineering teams and people managers.

·       Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale data engineering delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment.

·       Hands-on technical depth with Databricks and Apache Spark, including Delta Lake and production pipeline design; Unity Catalog and Databricks Workflows experience is strongly desired.

·       Strong experience with Python, SQL, automated testing, source control, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and cloud-native delivery.

·       Experience designing and operating batch and streaming pipelines, lakehouse or warehouse solutions, APIs, and event-driven integrations.

·       Experience implementing or governing AI-assisted development tools and practices in an enterprise engineering environment.

·       Working knowledge of data and AI governance, security, privacy, metadata, lineage, data quality, and production controls.

·       Strong business acumen, written and verbal communication, problem solving, prioritization, and executive stakeholder management skills.
