Your Role on Our Team:

As a Sr Oracle Platform Analyst - Manufacturing & Inventory, you are a senior Oracle Fusion practitioner who owns the functional health, design, and evolution of assigned Manufacturing and Inventory capabilities. You work hands-on within delivery to turn prioritized business capabilities into scalable, standardized Oracle solutions, favoring enterprise process patterns over unnecessary customization. You bring deep Oracle functional expertise, troubleshooting skill, and mentorship to the Oracle Platform Team, serving as a senior escalation point for complex platform issues.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Own the functional health and evolution of assigned Oracle Fusion Manufacturing and Inventory Management capabilities and Oracle Cost Management, proactively identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve the platform.

• Champion standardized Oracle capabilities and enterprise process patterns, thoughtfully evaluating exceptions based on business value, scalability, and long-term platform sustainability.

• Design and deliver scalable, reliable Oracle Fusion solutions while contributing to the architectural strategy and standards for Manufacturing and Inventory capabilities.

• Configure Oracle Fusion hands-on across work definitions, work orders, production reporting, item and cost setup, on-hand balances, material movement, replenishment, and cycle counting, and support integrations to shop floor, warehouse, and planning systems.

• Own assigned platform deliverables through design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization.

• Partner with Product Owners, business process leaders, architects, Quality Engineering, and other delivery disciplines to translate prioritized capabilities into scalable Oracle solutions.

• Serve as a senior escalation point and subject matter expert for complex Manufacturing, Inventory and Costing platform issues, driving root cause analysis through to durable resolution.

• Assess Oracle Fusion quarterly releases and new capabilities, determining business impact, adoption opportunities, regression risk, and required platform changes.

• Build deep knowledge of manufacturing, inventory, distribution, and Costing processes, and explain Oracle capabilities, constraints, and tradeoffs in business terms.

• Support the stability, performance, and scalability of assigned capabilities across manufacturing plants and distribution centers, including critical business events.

• Maintain appropriate solution documentation and traceability throughout the platform delivery lifecycle.

• Mentor and elevate less experienced Oracle Platform analysts through knowledge sharing, solution design review, and hands-on technical guidance.

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field, and/or equivalent technical and business experience.

• Multiple years of hands-on experience configuring and supporting Oracle Fusion SCM Manufacturing and Inventory in a functional platform role.

• Strong knowledge of manufacturing and inventory business processes, including make-to-stock and make-to-order production, work order execution, backflushing, inventory accuracy, and warehouse and material handling.

• Demonstrated functional solution and platform design capability, with the judgment to translate business needs into scalable, standardized Oracle capabilities rather than unnecessary customization.

• Ability to troubleshoot complex Oracle issues and perform root cause analysis across configuration, data, and integrated processes.

• Working understanding of integrations between Oracle Fusion and connected shop floor, warehouse, and planning systems.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to explain Oracle capabilities, constraints, and tradeoffs to business and technical audiences across global teams.

• Ability to operate independently as a senior practitioner, owning deliverables end to end and knowing when to escalate.

• Ability to mentor and elevate less experienced analysts through knowledge sharing and solution design review.

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

• Experience supporting critical manufacturing and inventory events such as month-end close, physical inventory, and production cutover.

• Familiarity with Oracle reporting and data tools such as OTBI, BI Publisher, FBDI, and ADFdi.

• Experience in a global manufacturing and distribution environment spanning multiple plants and distribution centers.

• Ability to travel to other Milwaukee Tool locations, including manufacturing and distribution sites, on occasion

We are seeking an experienced Staff Network Engineer to help design, support, and modernize our global enterprise network environment. As a recognized technical authority within the network domain, you will contribute to architectural decisions, design robust multi-system solutions, drive adoption of best practices, and mentor other engineers. This role spans enterprise wireless, network access control (NAC), routing, switching, next-generation firewalls, and SD-WAN, with significant ownership of hardware lifecycle programs and operational excellence across a global, multi-site enterprise.

Core Technology Stack: Enterprise wireless (cloud-managed) · Network access control (NAC) · Next-generation firewalls · SD-WAN · Enterprise routing & switching · Network automation

Technical Leadership & Solution Design

• Serve as a recognized technical authority in enterprise networking; contribute to architectural decisions and evaluate emerging technologies for adoption.

• Design new network components and enhance existing ones independently, ensuring clean integration with current architecture.

• Develop solutions that integrate across multiple systems, weighing technical trade-offs for scalability, performance, and maintainability.

• Design and implement governance standards across projects; drive adoption of engineering-excellence practices.

Enterprise Network Engineering & Support

• Provide advanced engineering and operational support across enterprise wireless, network access control (NAC), routing, switching, next-generation firewalls, and SD-WAN.

• Lead troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis on complex, cross-platform network incidents.

• Design and implement network enhancements aligned with architectural and security best practices.

• Develop and execute test plans to validate network changes and deployments.

Hardware Lifecycle Management

• Own lifecycle programs for a large inventory of network hardware - switches, wireless access points, firewalls, and SD-WAN devices.

• Plan and drive hardware upgrades, refresh projects, WAN circuit migrations, and decommissioning across multiple locations.

• Maintain accurate documentation of inventory, lifecycle stages, and platform dependencies.

• Partner with procurement, logistics, and field resources to ensure seamless deployment and transitions.

Operational Excellence & Change Management

• Design and implement operational excellence practices across network systems; proactively monitor and maintain system health.

• Lead incident response efforts and drive post-incident improvements.

• Develop and own engineering-approved change plans; ensure changes follow structured change-management processes.

• Establish documentation standards and ensure consistency across projects; champion documentation as a core function (network diagrams, standards, lifecycle plans, runbooks).

Collaboration, Mentorship & Stakeholder Engagement

• Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning multiple teams, mentor others on collaboration and stakeholder management.

• Assess skill gaps within the team and develop targeted learning plans; conduct knowledge-transfer sessions to grow team capability.

• Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Develop accurate estimates for complex, multi-team projects; identify dependencies and risks that impact timelines.

Required Skills & Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in enterprise network engineering, with demonstrated depth across enterprise wireless, routing, switching, and firewall technologies.

• Strong hands-on expertise with cloud-managed enterprise wireless, network access control (NAC), next-generation firewalls, and SD-WAN in a production enterprise environment.

• Proven ability to design robust solutions and mentor others on technical approaches.

• Experience supporting large-scale, multi-site network environments.

• Solid understanding of network security principles, segmentation, and best practices.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, including leading Root Cause Analysis.

• Experience contributing to organizational standards, governance, and change-management practices.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. title: Design Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Design Engineer – Batteries and Chargers

The Design Engineer’s primary role uses mechanical engineering expertise to contribute to the design and development of new products and support of existing products within the department.

About Us

Milwaukee is an industry-leading manufacturer and marketer of heavy-duty, portable electric power tools, accessories and hand tools for professional users worldwide. Since its founding in 1924, Milwaukee has focused on a single vision: To produce the best heavy-duty electric power tools and accessories available to the professional user. Today, the Milwaukee name stands for the highest quality, most durable and most reliable professional tools money can buy. Milwaukee currently employs approximately 1,500 people globally. The company continues to set industry standards, targeting professional tool users of all types with a product line that includes more than 500 tools, 3,500 accessories and 200 hand tools. Throughout its history Milwaukee's commitment to quality has remained steadfast. Quality is instilled using state-of-the-art technologies and sophisticated manufacturing techniques.

Day in the Life

As a Design Engineer for Milwaukee you will be located at our Brookfield, WI office. Our corporate office is only 15 minutes from downtown Milwaukee and located near American Family Field, Milwaukee Zoo, Mitchell Park Domes, as well as many more attractions and restaurants. You will work in a fast-paced environment to innovate new products as a member of a cross-functional team. One of the most rewarding aspects of the job is seeing a product you designed on the shelves of a Home Depot.

If you are interested in travel, domestic and international travel opportunities are available and sometimes required. In the US, Milwaukee Tool has three locations in Mississippi (two manufacturing and one distribution). Overseas, you will have the opportunity to work with Chinese engineering counterparts as well as meet with suppliers in Vietnam, Taiwan, and China.

Milwaukee offers benefits on your first day of work including health, dental, vision, life insurance and 401k. Milwaukee also provides an excellent working environment that includes an on-site cafeteria, state of the art fitness facility, recreational sports leagues and company outings.

Duties and Responsibilities

• Take a concept idea and make it come to life.

• Design and test products from concept to production.

• Develop design solutions to meet consumer requirements.

• Participate in field research.

• Facilitate project flow involving regular contact with manufacturing and other cross-functional team members.

• Interact with suppliers to develop part/product specifications that meet performance requirements while falling within process capabilities.

• Evaluate product design relative to material selection, cost and reliability.

• Perform a wide variety of calculations and software aided analyses in the following areas:

• Mechanical stress analysis, material and heat treatment selection, tolerance and fit analyses, statics and dynamics, noise and vibration, thermal heat transfer, and a variety of machine element design.

• Independently develop, write, and analyze test requests with the Milwaukee Tool Test Laboratory.

• Work as a technical resource to troubleshoot problems with manufacturing teams and suppliers.

Education and Experience Requirements

• Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical Engineering; or similar field.

• 2+ years of experience in related design field.

• GD&T and CAD proficiency

• Excellent problem-solving skills and a hands-on attitude.

• High proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, especially Excel and Power Point.

• Willingness to learn skill sets outside primary discipline.

• Ability to travel 10% of the time is required (travel includes Domestic and International).

• High interest in tools of the trade.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Financial Analyst I
description:
Job Description:

INNOVATE without boundaries!

At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success -- so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to provide support to your business unit.

Behind our doors you'll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to support the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you'll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Identify knowledge gaps and develop tools, processes, and models to provide meaningful information to internal customers.

• Develop peer relationships with other financial analysts to drive consistency in reporting, analysis, and operational procedures and rhythm.

• Demonstrate a commitment to continuous process improvement. Identify and eliminate non-value-added activities and streamline processes.

• Demonstrate ability to manage multiple processes and prioritize appropriately.

• Assist in preparation of rolling 18 month forecast.

title: Financial Systems Analyst II
description:
Job Description:

Your Role on Our Team:

Milwaukee Tool is seeking a Financial Systems Analyst to administer and improve the platforms, data processes, and controls supporting financial planning, reporting, allocations, and decision support. The role emphasizes system reliability, secure access, accurate data, user support, testing, documentation, and process automation. Finance knowledge provides valuable business context, but the primary focus is enterprise system administration and continuous improvement.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

System Administration & Support

• Administer the Milwaukee Tool EPM solution, including access, security roles, workflows, metadata, dimensions, hierarchies, forms, reports, and allocations.

• Monitor recurring processes, troubleshoot failures, coordinate resolution, and communicate impacts.

• Provide functional user support, document root causes, and escalate technical defects when appropriate.

• Support upgrades, patches, releases, regression testing, and environment readiness.

Data, Integrations & Controls

• Support data loads, mappings, interfaces, validations, reconciliations, and outbound reporting processes.

• Execute and validate recurring data and allocation processes for completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.

• Develop control checks, exception reporting, and audit documentation that strengthen data integrity.

Process Improvement & Partnership

• Identify manual or error-prone activities and recommend standardized, automated, or system-enabled alternatives.

• Use root-cause analysis to reduce recurring issues, risk, and cycle time.

• Partner with Finance, Accounting, IT, data teams, and vendors to deliver reliable, supportable solutions.

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

• Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 2-4 years supporting enterprise applications, business systems, data processes, or reporting platforms.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, prioritization, documentation, and communication skills.

• Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including strong Excel capability, and ability to collaborate across functions.

The TOOLS we prefer you have:

• Experience with an enterprise performance management, planning, consolidation, or reporting platform.

• Experience with security, metadata, workflows, reports, allocations, or financial data models.

• Familiarity with integrations, SQL, APIs, ETL, scripting, workflow automation, testing, ticketing, or agile tools.

• Working knowledge of planning, management reporting, month-end processes, and internal controls.

Capabilities for Success

Systems thinking | Structured problem solving | Customer focus | Technical curiosity | Change discipline | Ownership | Continuous improvement

• Success is reflected in reliable recurring processes, secure and accurate system configuration, timely issue resolution, well-tested enhancements, reduced manual effort, and strong stakeholder adoption.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

•
Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans

•
Generous 401 (K) savings plan

•
Education assistance

•
On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service

•
And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Quality Technician (2nd Shift)
description:
Job Description:

The Quality Technician is responsible for ensuring the quality of all products produced meet agreed upon standards and expectations.

This job description lists major areas of responsibility and additional job activities may be added at any time.

Duties and Responsibilities

• Use a variety of quality inspection tools including calipers, micrometers, height gauges, hardness testing, UPC scanners, paint thickness testers and other lab equipment

• Operate CMM and Vision System Inspection equipment

• Complete Non-Conforming Material Reports (NCMR’s) as needed and complete appropriate ERP/Oracle transactions

• Ensure packaging requirements are met by completing daily packaging conformance audits

• Complete dimensional inspections of incoming raw material

• Ability to navigate document repository web page to locate inspection reports, blueprints and other quality documents

• Develop and maintain effective working relationships within team environment

• Perform basic shop floor math, such as fraction to decimal conversion, arithmetic and units of measure conversion

• Problem solving abilities, interpersonal skills, and the ability to manage interruptions is required

• Consciously abide by all safety policies and procedures to create a safe working environment

• Other duties as assigned

Education and Experience

• High School or GED diploma required

• One (1) year of previous quality technician experience preferred

• Understanding of metrology fundamentals preferred

• Basic understanding of Microsoft Suite (e.g. Outlook, Excel)

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• Ability to work independent

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Field Sales and Marketing Representative - Dallas, TX
description:
Job Description:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provide TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in driving market share growth and maintaining TTI’s premier product lines within The Home Depot—our most valued and influential retail partner. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. Your contributions will directly impact TTI’s presence in the retail space, positioning you for continued advancement within the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.

• Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through.

• Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.

• Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact.

• Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics.

• Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market.

• Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships.

• Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities.

• Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

• Must be at least 21 years of age or older.

• Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

• Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

• Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.

• Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

• Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

• Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

• Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

• Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.

• Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.

• Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

• Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

• Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

• Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

• The applicant must be MS Office proficient.

• Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.

• Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.

• Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits:

• Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)

• The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000

• Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)

• Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year

• Company iPhone and iPad

• Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available

• Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more

• 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)

• Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holiday (Based on hire date)

• Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date

• Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business

• Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

Job Postings are available for at least 48 hours from the posting date. TTI accepts ongoing applications and will evaluate based on the needs of the business.

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at www.ttirecruiting.com.

title: Repair Technician
description:
Job Description:

Repair Technician

We are seeking highly motivated and experienced Repair Technicians at our Factory Service Centers to join our dynamic team! Under the direction of the Factory Service Center Branch Manager, the Repair Technicians will be responsible for diagnosing and performing quality repair and servicing the Milwaukee Tool product line in accordance with prescribed procedures to ensure proper functioning, safety and reliability, deliver a high level of customer support and satisfaction, and drive operational efficiency in the Factory Service Center. The ideal candidate will possess technical expertise and a customer-centric approach.

Duties and Responsibilities

Culture Alignment:

• Demonstrate Milwaukee Culture expectations to maximize organizational capacity and contribute to a collaborative, high-performing team.

•
Align with the Factory Service Center Branch Manager’s efforts to train, coach & mentor for continuous improvement in his/her performance.

•
Drive cross-functional engagement with key business partners to achieve strategic objectives and exceed metrics.

Operational Excellence:

• Perform disassembly of units, diagnosis of operating difficulty, location, and replacement of worn or defective parts within expected times and troubleshoot by work instructions.

•
Assist in answering alarm calls and take necessary action to secure company property and goods.

•
Execute prescribed maintenance, calibration, certification, and inspections using parts sheets, specifications, and drawings made.

•
Apply problem-solving skills to address issues and provide timely solutions.

•
Set up and perform electrical and mechanical tests to ensure that the product's repair and/or work performed conforms to prescribed quality standards and is safe for customers.

•
Keep records of parts used and provide data for billing and/or warranty information.

•
Track spare parts inventory and order replacements as needed to ensure they are readily available for repairs.

Customer Service Excellence:

•
Assist in creating ideas to improve end user experience and loyalty.

•
Position self as an knowledgeable and resource for the Field Sales, Marketing, and Service organizations in supporting and implementing new product development processes, programs, and operations.

•
Drive resolution for customer and Milwaukee Field Sales escalations for repairs, warranty guidelines, and program support.

•
Act as a liaison between Service branches and our end users.

•
Respond to customer inquiries and requests and assist in performing counter procedures in a timely and professional manner via phone, email, chat, or in-person interactions.

•
Engage with end users to understand product service needs, provide updates on repair progress, answer questions, and address concerns.

•
Offer instruction and support to end users on proper equipment usage and basic troubleshooting procedures.

•
Maintain proficiency on the current line of products through training to drive productivity and high-level quality of repair while engaging in training on new products to expand capabilities and enhance technical skills.

•
Fill and pack orders and repairs for shipment to customers; prepare shipping documents and determine shipping charges by prescribed procedures.

•
Ensure accurate and timely order fulfillment and maintain end user records and databases with up-to-date information, including notes for future reference and analysis.

Quality, Safety & Continuous Improvement

•
Report operational irregularities and defective materials for quality control.

•
Recommend areas for improvement and assist in process enhancements.

•
Support initiatives to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.

•
Help implementation and practice and execute 6S

•
Maintain and update required resources, fixtures, and equipment within the branch to ensure locations follow Milwaukee Service quality and standards.

Education and Experience Requirements

•
Requires an education equivalent to a high school diploma or GED.

•
1-2 years of previous experience in electrical and/or mechanical repair is preferred.

•
1-3 years of experience in a customer service position is preferred.

•
Proficiency in using various hand and power tools, diagnostic equipment, and software.

•
Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.

•
Ability to maneuver heavy material weighing up to 300 lbs.

•
Must possess practical business communication skills and the ability to understand the local branch market.

•
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities are crucial for diagnosing and repairing equipment issues.

•
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and customer service skills for dealing with end users and customers.

•
Adherence to safety protocols and guidelines is paramount to ensure personal safety and the safety of others.

•
Acquire and maintain industry or product-specific certifications or licenses that may be required.

•
Proficiency in English, written and verbal.

•
Bilingual (English/Spanish) a plus.

•
Must be proficient in computer skills and Microsoft Office applications.

•
Ability to travel up to 10% using the quickest and most cost-effective mode of transportation (Flight, Bus, Train, & etc.)

This position offers an hourly pay range of $26.50 - $31 in addition to comprehensive benefits including health insurance, paid time off, and retirement options.

title: Sr. Project Engineer - Systems, Reliability and Test
description:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one.

All our teams touch every step of the process, that is why our Engineering teams are some of the key contributors to our continuous innovations. The fast-paced, agile environment continuously delivers disruptive technologies by providing every team with the resources needed to excel and working directly with End Users to understand how to deliver heavy duty products with high performance. We create Best in Class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes and cross-functional agility.

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.  Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE.

The Senior Project Engineer will utilize advanced test development and analysis skills to contribute to the development and qualification of power tool products. This is a hands-on position where the candidate will be required to gain an understanding in the usage and operation of the tools/equipment under development.  Throughout a product's development cycle, this position requires strong cross-functional communication, requirements management, data analytics, and hands-on failure analysis to help launch new and exciting solutions that meet user needs. This is a fast-paced environment full of opportunities for innovation in new product test methods.  The senior engineer will also mentor and support less experienced engineers in technical development.

Duties and Responsibilities

•
Act as subject matter expert with respect to product testing, reliability, requirements management and warranty analysis for new product designs and engineering changes

•
Collaborate with design engineers and marketing to define the product specifications with respect to product life, durability, quality, and user needs

•
Participate in, and conduct, design reviews to showcase project status, risks, and system readiness for testing and verification activities

•
Develop and execute reliability, design, and validation assessments to support successful product introductions based on data driven evidence

•
Responsible for ensuring completion of product qualification test plans, including functional, reliability, and durability testing

•
Develop test procedures and prove out test methods based on new or established product designs to ensure power tools meet customer requirements

•
Analyze and present product usage and risk assessments utilizing statistical techniques such as Weibull analysis, reliability distributions and stress-strength analysis

•
Ensure timely failure reporting and perform root cause analysis for issues observed in life testing and/or field use

•
Occasionally join end user research events to identify "critical to quality" (CtQ) requirements on mechanical and electrical design features

•
Interact with global engineers, suppliers and manufacturing that participate in product commercialization

•
Track and support multiple projects simultaneously to ensure adherence to schedule and the Milwaukee Tool process

Qualifications

•
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, systems, robotics or other related engineering field

•
5 or more years of experience in product development, systems, reliability, test or similar function

•
Experience including systems engineering fundamentals, requirements management and proven ability to lead a primary function within a project team

•
Background in test development, verification, data collection and analytics.  Experience with HALT and other reliability test methods a plus

•
Strong analytical problem-solving skills and sound statistical application in areas such as Design of Experiments, sampling techniques, regression, reliability, FMEA, hypothesis testing, etc.

•
Experience with life data analysis, reliability distributions, and related software is a plus (e.g. Minitab, Reliasoft Weibull++)

•
Strong communication skills with the ability to influence at all levels with creative problem-solving capabilities.

•
Demonstrates excellent organizational skills and ability to support multiple projects simultaneously

•
Knowledge / Experience with the phases of residential and commercial construction as well as equipment usage is a plus

•
Ability to travel 5-10% of the time is required (travel includes Domestic and International)

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Brand Marketing Manager - Mexico and Latin America
description:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc. dba TTI Power Equipment, has an opening in its Anderson, SC office for a Brand Marketing Manager that will lead the division's brand marketing strategy across the Mexico and Latin America markets. The ideal candidate should be a strategic thinker, strong communicator, and collaborative leader with the ability to drive marketing initiatives across multiple markets while managing a high-performing team. The Brand Marketing Manager should be a self-starter that excels at building relationships, managing priorities, influencing cross-functional partners, and delivering business results. They should have a passion for brand marketing, commercialization, digital marketing, and developing innovative strategies that grow the business. We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package -- tuition assistance, 401(k), medical/dental/vision coverage, vacation and holidays.

Primary Responsibilities

•
Lead the development and execution of integrated brand marketing strategies across the Mexico and Latin America markets, ensuring alignment with business objectives, brand priorities, and go-to-market initiatives.

•
Manage and develop a team responsible for executing brand marketing initiatives across Mexico and Latin America by providing leadership, coaching, prioritization, and professional development.

•
Serve as the primary Brand Marketing representative for Mexico and Latin America leadership meetings by communicating project updates, business priorities, marketing performance, and strategic recommendations.

•
Work closely with Sales, Channel Marketing, Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to identify opportunities that accelerate business growth through product launches, seasonal promotions, retail campaigns, and strategic marketing initiatives.

•
Partner with internal and external agency partners to ensure resources are effectively utilized, deliverables meet brand standards, and marketing investments maximize business impact.

•
Provide guidance and support to the team on social media content development, creative execution, channel growth, as well as strategic direction for influencer marketing initiatives.

•
Monitor marketing performance across channels by reviewing key business metrics and identifying opportunities to optimize campaigns, improve efficiencies, and drive continued business growth.

•
Oversee the regional brand marketing budget, including influencer marketing, paid media, agency investment, product sampling, content creation, and other marketing initiatives while ensuring responsible financial management.

Requirements

•
Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.

•
Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish (written and verbal) required. Portuguese proficiency is a plus.

•

title: Senior Industrial Designer
description:
Job Description:

Senior Industrial Designer – Metal Working/Concrete/Rotary Hammer Team

On-site - Brookfield, Wisconsin

Milwaukee Tool is seeking a creative Senior Industrial Designer to join our Metal Working/Concrete/Rotary Hammer Team. In this role, you will drive design excellence and contribute to the expansion of our product lineup. If you are passionate about innovation and user-centered design, we encourage you to apply.

What You’ll Be Doing -

As a Senior Industrial Designer, you will develop high-performance products focused on real professionals in the trades. You will engage deeply with user needs, exploring forms and functions to enhance the interaction between users and tool.

Daily responsibilities -

•
Lead complex, strategic power tool projects while mentoring other designers.

•
Conduct research through field visits, trend analysis, and brainstorming sessions to identify unmet needs to generate fresh ideas.

•
Transform concepts into reality using sketches, 3D models, and visual storytelling, collaborating with cross-functional teams to bring concepts to reality.

•
Manage the entire design process—from ideation to pre-production—balancing creativity with technical details such as CMF requirements, product graphics, and manufacturing considerations.

•
Work closely with marketing, product managers, and engineers to ensure designs meet performance, cost, and schedule objectives.

Qualifications -

•
Bachelor’s degree in industrial design or equivalent from an accredited university.

•
7+ years of experience in product development, preferably in consumer products or durable goods.

•
Proven leadership skills with a strategic approach to guiding design teams.

•
Portfolio demonstrating strong product design, creativity, and critical thinking.

•
Proficient in sketching, CAD modeling, and visual storytelling, with experience in software such as Blender, SolidWorks, or similar.. Strong Blender skills, or the ability/willingness to quickly learn, are highly desired.

•
Open to domestic and international travel as needed.

If you're ready to take the next step, please send us a link to your resume/portfolio or website along with your application.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

title: SVP - Chief Financial Officer, Latin America
description:
Job Description:

TTI Professional (Milwaukee Tool) & Consumer (Ryobi) Businesses

At TTI, our people and culture are the foundation of our success. We are committed to developing leaders who drive innovation, move with speed and urgency, challenge the status quo, and build high-performing teams capable of delivering exceptional results.

The Chief Financial Officer, Latin America is the senior-most finance executive for the region, accountable for the financial strategy, performance, governance, capital allocation, risk management, and long-term value creation of Milwaukee Tool’s professional business and Ryobi’s consumer business throughout Latin America. This leader serves as a strategic partner to the regional business president, global finance leadership, and TTI executive leadership, providing the financial judgment, discipline, and enterprise perspective needed to accelerate profitable growth, scale the organization, and steward the region’s financial health.

This role is ideal for a commercially minded CFO who can operate as both strategist and steward, shaping business strategy, testing investment choices, protecting financial integrity, and building the finance infrastructure required to support a complex, fast-growing, multi-country business.

Your Responsibilities

Own Financial Strategy, Performance, and Value Creation

•
Serve as the senior financial steward for Latin America, accountable for regional financial strategy, business performance, capital discipline, and long-term value creation.

•
Own the region’s financial outcomes, including revenue growth, profitability, margin expansion, cash flow, working capital, capital efficiency, and return on invested capital.

•
Lead long-range financial planning, annual operating planning, forecasting, performance management, scenario modeling, and monthly business reviews that translate strategy into measurable financial plans.

•
Advise regional and corporate leadership on capital allocation, investment prioritization, pricing strategy, market expansion, cost structure, and resource tradeoffs.

•
Ensure regional financial commitments are delivered while balancing near-term performance with sustainable growth, enterprise risk, and shareholder value creation.

Serve as Strategic CFO and Executive Business Partner

•
Operate as a trusted advisor to the regional president, global finance leadership, and TTI executive leadership on the financial implications of business strategy, growth priorities, and major operating decisions.

•
Bring an enterprise perspective to decision-making by connecting financial performance, commercial strategy, operational execution, risk, talent, and organizational capability.

•
Partner with commercial, product, marketing, operations, and supply chain leaders to evaluate strategic investments, pricing and margin opportunities, channel strategy, product launches, M&A opportunities, and market expansion initiatives.

•
Provide executive-level financial narratives, insights, and recommendations for regional and corporate operating reviews, strategic planning discussions, investment decisions, and governance forums.

•
Identify material risks, opportunities, and performance gaps early; recommend clear actions to protect the business, improve returns, and accelerate growth.

Build a Scalable, High-Performing Finance Organization

•
Recruit, develop, and retain a world-class finance organization across multiple countries.

•
Create strong succession plans and leadership development pipelines.

•
Develop financial acumen throughout the organization and act as a coach to business leaders.

•
Build scalable systems, processes, and structures that support future growth.

•
Foster collaboration across regional and global teams while reinforcing a One-Team mentality.

Lead Governance, Risk, Controls, Tax, Treasury, and Financial Integrity

•
Own the region’s accounting, controllership, financial reporting, tax, treasury, audit, compliance, and internal control environment across multiple countries and currencies.

•
Ensure financial integrity, policy adherence, statutory compliance, corporate governance, and strong stewardship of company assets across all Latin America operations.

•
Manage regional liquidity, cash flow, foreign exchange exposure, working capital, tax planning, and capital structure considerations in partnership with corporate finance and treasury.

•
Lead audit readiness, risk mitigation, control remediation, and governance improvements that strengthen transparency, accountability, and confidence in regional financial results.

•
Drive simplification, automation, standardization, and analytics capabilities that improve speed, accuracy, decision support, and the scalability of the finance function.

Lead Growth, Transformation, and Strategic Change

•
Provide CFO leadership for new market expansion, acquisitions, integration activity, business model evolution, and organizational scaling across Latin America.

•
Lead cross-functional initiatives requiring financial strategy, business case development, governance, stakeholder alignment, and disciplined execution across countries and functions.

•
Champion adoption of systems, tools, dashboards, and operating rhythms that increase financial visibility, improve forecast accuracy, and enable faster executive decision-making.

•
Model a culture of ownership, constructive challenge, financial discipline, transparency, and relentless improvement.

The successful candidate will demonstrate TTI’s leadership expectations and cultural competencies:

Drives Growth & Innovation

•
Thinks strategically while maintaining strong operational execution.

•
Identifies new opportunities to accelerate profitable growth.

•
Challenges conventional thinking and drives innovative solutions.

Drives Execution

•
Delivers commitments with speed, urgency, and accountability.

•
Establishes clear priorities and aligns resources to maximize impact.

•
Balances short-term results with long-term business objectives.

Builds Collaborative Relationships

•
Creates trust across functions, geographies, and leadership levels.

•
Influences without authority and successfully navigates complex organizations.

•
Communicates candidly, directly, and constructively.

Builds Organizational Capacity

•
Recruits and develops exceptional talent.

•
Provides frequent, actionable coaching and feedback.

•
Creates an engaged, high-performing culture that scales with business growth.

•
Fosters transparency and encourages issue escalation and problem solving.

Qualifications

•
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related field required.

•
MBA and/or CPA preferred.

•
Executive presence and credibility to influence senior leaders, challenge assumptions, communicate complex financial issues clearly, and represent the region in corporate governance and strategic planning forums.

•
15+ years of progressive finance leadership experience, including experience as a CFO, divisional CFO, regional CFO, or senior finance executive for a complex, multi-country business.

•
Demonstrated success leading financial strategy, capital allocation, enterprise planning, performance management, treasury, tax, controls, compliance, and governance in an international environment.

•
Strong commercial orientation with experience partnering directly with presidents, general managers, corporate CFOs, and executive leadership teams to shape business strategy and improve financial returns.

•
Experience operating in high-growth, matrixed, multi-currency environments with the ability to balance speed, control, local complexity, and enterprise standards.

•
Deep understanding of accounting, internal controls, audit, tax, treasury, regulatory requirements, and compliance expectations across Latin America.

•
Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing finance teams with succession depth, business partnership capability, and strong controllership discipline.

•
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese strongly preferred.

•
Location in LA region and/or South Florida

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Transportation Analyst
description:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc. has an opening in its Anderson, SC office for a Transportation Analyst. The Transportation Analyst supports domestic and international transportation operations by optimizing carrier selection, managing freight spend, monitoring transportation performance, ensuring customs compliance, and providing analytical support to supply chain operations. This role partners closely with distribution, supply chain, sales, finance, customs brokers, and transportation providers to ensure the efficient and cost-effective movement of goods throughout the supply chain.

We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package, including tuition assistance, 401(k), medical, dental and vision coverage, paid vacation, and company holidays.

Primary Responsibilities

•
Contact air, ocean, and surface transportation carriers to secure the most cost-effective carrier selection for standard and expedited shipments while ensuring required management approvals are obtained.

•
Review invoices from ocean carriers, trucking companies, and international freight forwarders. Research discrepancies and attach supporting documentation prior to submission to the Sr. Director of Transportation.

•
Develop and maintain carrier performance scorecards and transportation databases to track key performance indicators (KPIs), including cost per mile, on-time delivery performance, freight cost, carrier utilization, and service performance.

•
Analyze transportation processes and identify opportunities for cost savings, service improvements, and operational efficiencies.

•
Update and distribute inbound container information to appropriate stakeholders while monitoring potential demurrage and detention charges. Communicate potential costs to warehouse and supply chain personnel and prepare monthly management reports.

•
Evaluate the current carrier network and recommend changes as necessary to ensure adequate capacity, service levels, and cost competitiveness.

•
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to provide freight cost estimates for new projects, product launches, and operational initiatives.

•
Coordinate export shipments with ocean carriers and air freight forwarders, including preparation and review of required shipping documentation.

•
Partner with supply chain teams, booking agents, steamship lines, and transportation providers to coordinate container diversions and provide status updates on inbound shipments.

•
Assist with domestic and international transportation, customs compliance, and special projects as assigned.

Qualifications

•
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant transportation or supply chain experience may be considered.

•
Three (3) or more years of transportation, logistics, customs compliance, supply chain, or related experience required.

•
Experience managing ocean, air, truckload, LTL, parcel, and intermodal transportation.

•
Knowledge of Incoterms, import/export procedures, and international trade practices.

•
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, and data analysis tools.

•
Experience working with transportation management systems (TMS), ERP systems, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and ocean carriers.

•
Working knowledge of U.S. Customs regulations and Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) classifications.

Physical Requirements

•
Ability to sit, stand, and work at a computer for extended periods.

•
Ability to occasionally lift up to 20 pounds.

•
Ability to work in both office and warehouse environments as business needs require.

Physical Demands and Reasonable Accommodation

The physical demands described herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Internal Qualifications

•
No active Final Written Warning at the time of application.

•
Must be in good standing and not currently on a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP).

•
No more than six (6) active attendance points at the time of application.

•
Must have met established productivity, quality, and performance expectations during the previous three months.

•
Must have been in current position for a minimum of six months.

•
Must meet the minimum qualifications listed in this job description.

title: Field Sales and Marketing Representative - Cincinnati, OH
description:
Job Description:

Field Sales and Marketing Representative – Techtronic Industries, NA (TTI)

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provide TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in driving market share growth and maintaining TTI’s premier product lines within The Home Depot—our most valued and influential retail partner. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. Your contributions will directly impact TTI’s presence in the retail space, positioning you for continued advancement within the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.

• Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through.

• Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.

• Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact.

• Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics.

• Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market.

• Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships.

• Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities.

• Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

• Must be at least 21 years of age or older.

• Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

• Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

• Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.

• Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

• Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

• Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

• Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

• Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.

• Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.

• Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

• Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

• Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

• Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

• The applicant must be MS Office proficient.

• Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.

• Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.

• Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits:

• Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)

• The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000

• Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)

• Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year

• Company iPhone and iPad

• Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available

• Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more

• 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)

• Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holiday (Based on hire date)

• Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date

• Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business

• Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

Job Postings are available for at least 48 hours from the posting date. TTI accepts ongoing applications and will evaluate based on the needs of the business.

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at www.ttirecruiting.com.

title: Industrial Engineer - Distribution
description:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc. has an opening in its Anderson, SC office for an Industrial Engineer - Distribution that will be responsible for the design, testing, and implementation of process and software improvement solutions for the distribution floor in the areas of personnel and equipment utilization, optimizing the flow of people, process, and material through the facility. We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package -- tuition assistance, 401(k), medical/dental/vision coverage, vacation and holidays.

Primary Responsibilities

•
Collaborating with highly technical cross-functional teams to ensure that the facility achieves desired efficiencies with the lowest possible costs. Influence, negotiate, and communicate with internal and external business partners, contractors and vendors

•
Develop process, procedures and testing of improvement solutions; create, maintain and provide associated documentation

•
Provide production support for new process implementations

•
Conduct time studies and task review to eliminate wastes and reduce bottlenecks, as well as to maximize productivity and balance lines/work cells within the operation.

•
Chair Kaizen/Lean/Continuous Improvement/Labor Management events with the corporate logistics group.

•
Develop operations measurement standards, as well as drive Activity Based Costing initiatives within the logistics group.

•
Manage network SKU slotting and fixed material handling utilization, as well as develop justifications for material handling solutions improvements.

•
Generate weekly divisional efficiency/productivity reports, as well as other distribution reports as needed.

•
Evaluate/establish new operational layouts/work cells.

•
Develop network best practices through continuous improvement, as well as provide focus through value stream mapping.

•
Establish standardization within the distribution network, as well as train operators/super-users as required. Responsible development, implementation, documentation, maintenance and support of engineered production standards and best-method practices

•
Evaluate inventory, labor, customer service and capital costs implications within projects.

•
Develop RFQ's and RFP's related to logistics projects, as well as work with outside vendors on development of project requirements based off of project scope. Also evaluates bids/vendor proposals.

Requirements

•
Requires a 4-year degree in engineering, operations, or related field; with 1-2 years of related experience

•
Experience working with complex automated material handling equipment and systems including warehouse management systems and warehouse control systems

•
Demonstrated use of analytical skills to solve complex process issues

Preferred Qualifications

•
5+ years of experience as a distribution engineer, process engineer, industrial engineer, manufacturing engineer, project manager or related occupation.

•
Outstanding communication, presentation and organization skills needed.

•
Skilled in using PC Office software (advanced with Excel, average or greater for Access DB, standard use of Word/email/other office software, Visio, PowerPoint, etc.), and AutoCAD. Warehouse Management Systems, RF, slotting software and SAP experience highly desired within a distribution center environment.

•
Project management experience and analytical planning experience.

•
Specialized skills in motion and time study, line balancing and ergonomics.

•
Extensive familiarity with various material handling equipment solutions (rolling stock and fixed material handling) required. Familiarity of conveyor control systems and warehouse management operating systems functionality desired.

•
Experience with warehouse layout and design.

•
Formal Lean training and application of Lean management within a distribution environment highly desired.

•
Knowledge of distribution cost elements, as well as inventory control drivers.

•
Knowledge of methods, time and motion, and process improvement.

title: Material Handler - A Shift
description:
Job Description:

The Material Handler is responsible for inventory storage, replenishment to manufacturing, and movement. Additionally, the Material Handler locates raw material and completes inventory reporting transactions in the ERP System for Work-In-Process (WIP) and Finished Goods.

This job description lists major areas of responsibility and additional job activities may be added at any time.

• Transport incoming and outgoing materials to designated areas

• Operate forklift, electrical hoist, or other power-driven equipment, to load or move materials

• Supply production areas with inventory (raw material and WIP)

• Utilize RF Smart to locate inventory and complete inventory transactions in the ERP System

• Safely operate a variety of material handling equipment.  Complete daily checklist for forklift equipment used

• Cross train and back up co-workers as required

• High School or GED diploma required

• Ability to operate a forklift, electrical hoist, or other power driven equipment

• Positive attitude and willingness to help as required

• Requires excellent oral and written communication skills

title: Talent Advisor - Organizational Effectiveness
description:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc. in Anderson, SC is looking for a Talent Advisor, Organizational Effectiveness. The Talent Advisor is a member of the Organizational Effectiveness Center of Excellence (OE COE), reporting to the Group Manager. The role supports the effective delivery and continuous improvement of Talent Cycle programs by coordinating processes, managing workforce data and reporting, and developing consistent tools and resources. Serving as a key connection point among HR Business Partners, HR specialty teams, leaders, and employees, the Talent Advisor helps ensure talent and employee-lifecycle processes are executed accurately, efficiently, and consistently. Through strong task management, attention to detail, discretion, and proactive follow-through, this role enables HR Business Partners to focus on strategic priorities while supporting a positive, People First employee experience.

Primary Responsibilities:

•
Provide day-to-day operational and coordination support to Talent Partners and other Talent teams, ensuring follow-through on HR actions, business priorities, documentation, deadlines, and process milestones.

•
Prepare reports, trackers, communications, presentations, meeting materials, and other resources that support HRBP and leadership discussions.

•
Serve as a coordination point among HRBPs, leaders, employees, Talent teams, HR specialty groups, and business stakeholders.

•
Coordinate performance management, talent reviews, calibration activities, development planning, engagement follow-up, employee listening, and workforce planning processes.

•
Develop and maintain tools, resources, communications, and training that support the Talent Cycle and other Talent programs.

•
Support New Hire Orientation and onboarding initiatives in partnership with Training & Development, Talent Management, and site stakeholders.

•
Coordinate employee lifecycle transactions, including hires, transfers, promotions, and status changes, organizational updates, and terminations.

•
Support consistent onboarding and offboarding experiences and direct routine employee and leader inquiries to the appropriate HR resources, processes, or systems.

•
Maintain accurate employee records, performance documentation, organizational data, HR files, forms, and correspondence in accordance with company requirements.

•
Maintain data integrity in Workday and other HR systems by ensuring employee, organizational, and reporting information remains accurate and current.

•
Create and maintain HR dashboards, reports, trackers, and workforce summaries covering headcount, turnover, open positions, engagement, compliance, and related metrics.

•
Identify and help resolve data discrepancies, workflow issues, process gaps, and documentation needs in partnership with HRBPs and HR Operations.

•
Support engagement surveys, recognition programs, service awards, culture initiatives, company events, and activities that reinforce organizational values.

•
Assist with talent planning, succession planning, employee development, retention actions, leadership support, audits, compliance reporting, and employee relations documentation.

•
Support change management and continuous improvement by evaluating programs, gathering feedback, simplifying and standardizing processes, documenting tools and SOPs, maintaining confidentiality, and building positive cross-functional relationships.

•
Performs other duties as assigned.

Technical Skills/Experience:

•
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

•
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and other Microsoft Office applications.

•
Knowledge of HR processes, employment practices, and compliance requirements preferred.

•
Experience working with HRIS systems and maintaining employee data is beneficial but not required.

•
Strong written and verbal communication skills

•
Must have strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to effectively prioritize and execute multiple competing responsibilities

CONSIDER

Working Conditions:

•
Primarily working indoors, office environment.

•
Periodic travel to various TTI locations.

•
May sit for several hours at a time.

•
Prolonged exposure to computer screens.

•
Moderate noise i.e. business office with computers, phone, and printers.

title: Trainer - Distribution
description:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, inc., has an opening in its Anderson, SC location for Trainer - Distribution 1st Shift). We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package -- tuition assistance, 401(k), medical/dental/vision coverage, vacation and holidays.

Duties and Responsibilities

• Provide equipment training for all positions on Powered Industrial Trucks. Will use the established work instructions, training material, and required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) to train an operator and follow up on their progress.

• Plans and facilitates training in conjunction with Standard Operating Procedures of the distribution departments.

• Maintain training files, both physical and electronic. Complete training documents via SharePoint Site and PowerApps.

• Develop training material in conjunction with the Training Manager, Safety and Management.

• Provide feedback on training or material such as work instructions and training documents in order to strive for continual improvement.

• Other duties as assigned.

Education and Experience Requirements

• High School education or 2-3 years of related experience

• This person is largely self-directed.

• Excellent English oral and written communication skills are required.

• Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

• Capable of interpreting and/or completing charts, schedules, reports, forms, and records.

• Must possess physical dexterity sufficient to accomplish required tasks.

• Capable of operating powered industrial trucks and equipment safely by following established work instructions.

• Must possess a cooperative attitude toward coworkers and management.

• Must operate equipment safely and wear specified PPE such as safety vest, ear plugs, safety glasses, etc., as deemed necessary for the safety of operator, coworkers and facility.

• Capable of working in a standing position 100% of the time.

• Continuous mental and visual attention requiring constant alertness or activity.

• Adhere to 5S methodology, which is to Sort, Set in Order (organize and identify), Shine (clean), Standardize and Sustain (maintain).

• Capable of lifting up to 50 lbs. with or without assistance.

• Available to work long hours and weekends, as needed.

• Maintain equipment in clean and good working order, reporting equipment problems to supervisor.

• Strive for continual improvement in departmental processes and functions.

• Adhere to General Warehouse safety and policies that provide for establishing a safe, healthy, and environmentally sound work environment for its employees.

• Adhere to the company’s safety rules laid out in the forklift training.

Physical Demands

• Standing for extended periods of time.

• Repetitive motion.

• Frequent bending, stooping, pushing, and pulling of parts and containers.

• Frequent lifting up to 50lbs – team lifts over 50lbs.

• Able to work in various temperature conditions.

Note *** The physical and weight-lifting demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Internal Qualifications

• No final warnings

• No more than 6 attendance points

• Efficiency and Quality goals met for the previous 3 months.

• Must be in current role for 6+ months.

• Must meet all job description requirements.

title: Emergency Services Associate
description:
Job Description:

TI Consumer Power Tools, Inc. has an opening in its Wellford, SC, distribution facility for an Emergency Services Officer I. An ideal candidate will have good communication skills, both written and verbal, and must give evidence of both. They will have to demonstrate excellent surveillance and emergency response skills as well as a strong commitment to security rules and knowledge of all hazards and threats to life safety and assets. We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package -- tuition assistance, 401(k), medical/dental/vision coverage, vacation, and holidays.

Officers primarily work fixed posts and may support additional assignments after completing required training.

Control access points and verify employee and visitor credentials

•
Monitor assigned posts, patrol areas, and security systems

•
Identify, report, and assist in resolving safety and security concerns

Operate security and monitoring systems (e.g., access control, alarms, cameras)

Monitor fire alarm panels and respond according to emergency procedures

•
Conduct routine patrols and maintain familiarity with buildings and campus layouts

•
Prepare clear, accurate, and objective incident reports

Respond appropriately to unsafe or high-risk situations

Communicate effectively via radio using established protocols

Provide professional, courteous service to employees, visitors, and vendors

De-escalate conflicts calmly and professionally

Complete required safety, compliance, and skills-based training

Basic computer skills and ability to use security-related software

CPR, First Aid, and AED certification

•
Completion of SLED Basics and Fire Extinguisher Training

•
Prior security, military, or law enforcement experience

•
Strong interpersonal and communication skills

Physical Requirements

•
Ability to remain alert in a dynamic environment

•
Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods

•
Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, and lift up to 50 lbs.

•
Ability to perform team lifts over 50 lbs. using safe lifting practices

Ability to perform CPR, including effective chest compressions

Ability to see, hear, and communicate clearly during emergencies

Why Join Us

Meaningful work that supports safety and service

•
Training and career development opportunities

Professional, team-oriented work environment

At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success -- so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to provide…

The Supervisor is responsible for directing and coaching employees.

• Solicits feedback from Managers, Team Leads and associates related to performance and takes corrective action when needed.

• Leads in the recruitment, hiring, promoting, and terminating processes as needed.

• Works with manager to ensure appropriate staffing levels.

• Sets schedules according to workload

• Fosters a high degree of morale among associates, including providing feedback, recognition, and rewards.
